snippet.title: Hell Maiden | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now in Early Access of Steam!

Hell Maiden is an action horde survival deck-building game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy. 

Follow Dante on a new adventure through Hell in search of a second chance at salvation!

⬇️Play now on Steam⬇️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372060?utm_source=yttr0525

📽️Trailer Production Credits

Video Editor: Howl
X/Twitter: https://x.com/hoowwl
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Howru

Sound Design & Mixing: Artur Sousa

Dialogue Editing & Processing: Miguel Cravinho, Artur Sousa

BGM: Skyleo
X/Twitter: @Skyleomusic

Creative Direction
AstralShift

❤️‍🔥More info
